session: prices keyed by every active stable security ID
rebalance: observations: exhaustive decision population, value, ticker, available_at, source_sha256
action_order: Caller supplies unique per-session sequences; actions precede rebalance. Dividends specify current share basis after earlier sequenced actions, ex-session entitlement and pay-session cash.
cash_merger: Known USD per-share amount; immediate same-session cash settlement only in v001
stock_merger: Positive exchange ratio and active successor ID; preserve fractional quantity
cancellation: Requires explicit zero-recovery evidence; delisting alone never authorizes cancellation
arithmetic: 34-digit Decimal; exact strings; no floats; fractional shares; sells before buys; charge actual turnover; no leverage or hidden cash scaling
marking: Complete open/close price set for all active identities; explicit terminal transition for every disappeared population ID; any unvalued position or receivable fails
reconciliation: All semantic output fields compared exactly, including population and observations. Engine metadata may differ. No numeric tolerance silently applied.
limits: No bid/ask, impact, order book, deferred merger payment, currency conversion, spinoff or OTC model
Nexus adapter always raises; no client or remote transport
